Name: Questable Tractor
Author: NermNermNerm
Description:
[b]New in version 1.4[/b]:
[list]
[*]TractorMod settings now work correctly - in the past this mod would overwrite user-supplied settings.  Now it basically just overrides them and leaves TractorMod's settings file alone.
[*]You can now control the area-of-effect of the tools during play with the "+" and "-" keys on your numeric keypad.  You have to be sitting on the tractor for those keys to work.  The normal area-of-effect is controlled by TractorMod's "Distance" setting defaults to "1" -- "1" more than the square your tractor is sitting on, so a 3x3 area.  If you hit the "-" key, it'll only touch the square your sitting on.  Pressing "+" again will put it back to its normal 3x3.  If you have reached farming level 10, you can press "+" again and make it a 5x5 area.  The limits are 0 and one more than your 'Distance' setting.  It will remember your last setting for each tool so, for example, you can just press + once for your watering tool so it's 5x5 then switch to the hoe, and it will go to 3x3 or whatever your last setting was for the hoe.  Please give feedback in the 'Posts' section on how this feature works; it feels like there's one or two good ideas yet to be found here.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][url=http://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]...or use a mod manager to install it.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png[/img]

Grandpa was a great guy, but maybe not that great at keeping his tractor in good shape.  You'll find parts of it around your farm - behind trees, under logs and rocks and, well, let's not spoil too much eh?  Granddad's antics with the tractor were the stuff of legend, so there's no shortage of gossip around town to help you get started.  Always start by talking to the villagers, but here are some further tips:

[list]
[*]There are many quests that require you to talk to villagers or bring villagers stuff.  The best way to do that and ensure that you're not accidentally gifting them is to hold the quest item (the broken tractor part, not what they asked you for) in your hand when approaching the villager.  If you don't have the quest object, hold nothing.  Even in quests where you have to bring an item to the villager, holding nothing will work - it's like the Lucky Purple Shorts quest - if the items are in your inventory, they get taken out and the quest proceeds.
[*]You should focus on getting the tractor unlocked before worrying about the parts. The tractor is very well hidden - thoroughly search the areas hinted at by the villagers.
[*]Pay close attention to villager chat - they'll start talking about it one week into the game.  Old timers will have more to say on the subject than relative newcomers to the town.
[*]This is built on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401?tab=description]TractorMod[/url]﻿, so you should familiarize yourself with that mod if you are not already.
[*]There are two items hidden under rocks and logs.  You don't need to break the log/rock to get the item (regardless of what the game might tell you).
[/list]
What you should expect:
[list]
[*]A really motivated player who routinely does first-year community center unlocks can get a fully unlocked tractor by the first day of summer if they really bear down on it and know what the quests will require in advance.  More casual users have a good chance to get the tractor and one or two attachments done in that time.
[*]To get the best out of this mod, you should start your game with it or add it in the first year.
[*]The gold requirements for the fully unlocked tractor are minimal (it's possible to do with as little as 350g), so it works well with playthroughs at lower profit margins.  The quests do require a substantial playtime to get through, and that's where the game balance comes in.
[*]MultiPlayer - Farmhands can run the tractor, but cannot complete or contribute meaningfully to quests.  [i]The reasoning behind it is the tractor and its capabilities are a function of the farm.  The missing parts and such wouldn't make sense if there were duplicates of them, and it seems bad to have the possibility that a missing farmhand could completely block progress because they had the one part that was needed to move forward.  If you think differently or know a way around this concern, post your thoughts![/i]
[*]There are several tools (most of them kindof silly) that TractorMod supports that there are no quests for (e.g. the watering can, weapons, shears, and the slingshot).  These are disabled until all of the questable things are unlocked.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]

Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.0 or later
[*]Windows for sure, Linux & MacOS probably (all testing is done on Windows.)
[*]In multiplayer, all players should have this mod and TractorMod.
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png[/img]﻿[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/NermNermNerm/QuestableTractor]Source Code[/url]﻿﻿
[/list]
